race.title: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: FAIRY PARK seems a bit of an edgy sort but she looked a good prospect on the evidence of her 2 bumper efforts last season, which she duly confirmed when hammering a next-time-out winner on her Ffos Las hurdling debut, and strikes as the type to go on to much better things. Expensive point recruit Royal Response impressed over C&D earlier in the month and is open to plenty of improvement, too, while the scopey Ti'mamzel shouldn't be taken lightly as a dual listed bumper winner. FAIRY PARK (IRE) ROYAL RESPONSE (IRE) TI'MAMZEL (FR)
